crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we…
He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
“Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Why is it judged incredible with you, if God does raise the dead?
As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who…
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from…

translations.web: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”
translations.bsb: Then He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones come to life?” “O Lord GOD,” I replied, “only You know.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, thou knowest.
